payload: Step 1 failed: MCP gateway (vn-market) unreachable — 'The connector's server isn't responding' on log_agent_work x2 + get_pending_ask_questions x1 (3 fresh live probes at 07:47:51Z–07:48:57Z). 8th consecutive BLOCKED cycle for qa-responder (00:48Z, 01:48Z, 02:48Z, 03:48Z, 04:48Z, 05:48Z, 06:49Z, 07:48Z); market-watcher confirms 8th consecutive failure at 07:40:33Z.
